subfamily: absinthe drip, syrup in the glass (Oxford ABSINTHE DRIP pdf 52: the early-1800s way)
glass: stemmed water goblet or large wine glass (240 ml or more)
_status: v3.1 (Tomás, round 5). Named bottle Lucid (62%, made to Ted Breaux's recipe; Hester F15), substitute style: any absinthe verte (swept 45-74%). Built in layers (syrup, absinthe poured gently, iced water in a thin slow trickle), stirred once before the first sip. Numbers are for the stirred drink.
